title: Task
description: Generic task-completion record from any task source. Extends the base Item directly (no description body — content lives in linked Note facts). Provider-specific extensions live in metadata.

source_id.description: Native task id in the source system (dedup key; the Task analogue of Email.rfc_message_id)

kind.description: Entry kind; documented convention 'task' | 'event', free string

status.description: Terminal state of the task ('skipped' reserved for sources that record skips)

status_updated_at.description: When the task reached this status (completion / don't-do decision / skip decision time)

duration.description: ISO-8601 duration, as given by the source
